name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
label: Quest
description: Your Fortune Awaits You...: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: "Your fortune awaits you outside Palemane Rock."

The fortune Sayge handed you feels slightly warm to the touch. Grasping it firmly, you see an image of the Palemane Rock of Mulgore. Focusing closer in on the image, you see a tree stump that sits close to the cave entrance.

clips.title: Progress
paras: This tree stump looks like the one from your vision.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A quick search of the tree stump reveals a lockbox from within it! It would seem that you have found your fortune!
